priority_assessment: I would keep flashnext-projection-exact/do ahead of the scorecard cleanup. Its exact-token mismatch was the one failure among 103 selected measurements. The published MOSS reading was 58.834 s for a 1024 x 1024, 50-step flow Euler request. The Ultra section comparison still needs its own workflow recording.

I would take SQA-527 before acting on the unmeasured inference and training rows. Six entries in those two rows ask for Qwen3.5-9B readings the plan deliberately carries. Removing those requests leaves the genuine gaps visible. SQA-528 comes second. The existing run report could identify a failed proof while other cells continue, using the error the validator already has.

findings.input: A recorded cells phase runs Flash-Next's projection-proof as a recipe verification. Its exact suite rejects image-1-bottom because the generated token has a leading space. Other selected cells can keep running. Read the existing measurement run report.
findings.expected: When the validator receives the failed proof's verdict, record its model, validation and concise cause in the active phase through plan.RecordFailure. The existing status reader can then report the failure while the other cells finish. Preserve the benchmark-specific marker used by scorecard publication and the distinct outcomes for inapplicable or contended measurements.
findings.actual: Observed at 3a7b3877d. The retained cells phase ended after 2 h 43 min 31 s with a failed verdict and no failed entry. The committed flashnext-projection-exact/do row names the mismatch. At 1251fe747, settle sends a failed projection proof only to the in-memory error list. Its persistent failure call is conditional on benchmark, which excludes projection proofs. The terminal error includes the cause, but MeasurementRun.Report cannot name the failed cell from the retained record.

SQA-527.note: Answered by the lead on 2026-11-28 at 1251fe747: valid from source (Record.gaps counts every carried cell as unmeasured, so Qwen3.5-9B's six readings, carried because the run selects Qwen3.5-4B, sit in the unmeasured inference and training rows beside genuine gaps). Filed as carried-unselected, ahead of the scorecard rows it thins: a carried reading of a model outside the run's selection is no gap, while a selected measurement that broke or yielded nothing stays one.

SQA-528.note: Answered by the lead on 2026-11-28 at 1251fe747: valid from source (settle records a failure in the phase only for a benchmark, so Flash-Next's broken projection proof reached the run's in-memory errors and its terminal error but never the record MeasurementRun.Report reads). Filed as proof-failure-recorded: a broken recipe proof is recorded through plan.RecordFailure as it breaks, keeping the benchmark marker publication reads and the distinct outcomes for cells that measured nothing.
